# The assets of a release, one per line: where the file comes from, then its
# name. Both release workflows read this list and nothing else names an asset.
#
#   release-<artifact>  the run artifact that must hold the file; release.yml
#                       fails unless the run's release-* artifacts are these
#                       files exactly
#   checkout            copied from the tagged commit's bin/ by release.yml
#
# release.yml uploads exactly these names to the draft. publish-on-master.yml
# reads the list from the commit the draft was built from and takes the draft
# public only if the draft holds exactly these names.
checkout SHA256SUMS
checkout qs-bitwarden-ssh-agent-x86_64-linux
checkout qs-bitwarden-unlock-key-x86_64-linux
checkout qs-bitwarden-vault-x86_64-linux

checkout qs-bitwarden-vault-aarch64-linux

release-reports vault-dependency-licences.json
release-reports dependency-tree-x86_64-linux.txt
release-reports unlock-key-dependency-tree-x86_64-linux.txt
release-reports vault-dependency-tree-x86_64-linux.txt
release-reports dependency-tree-aarch64-linux.txt
release-reports unlock-key-dependency-tree-aarch64-linux.txt
release-reports vault-dependency-tree-aarch64-linux.txt
